body:
## Pull request overview

This PR reduces list page toolbar clutter by hiding the runtime ViewSwitcher by default, aligning the UI with a “view type fixed at creation-time” model (configured via ViewDesigner / schema), rather than encouraging runtime switching.

**Changes:**
- Updated `ObjectViewSchema.showViewSwitcher` documentation to reflect a new default of `false`.
- Switched `ObjectView`’s ViewSwitcher rendering from opt-out (`!== false`) to opt-in (`=== true`).
- Added a `showViewSwitcher` prop to `ListView` (default `false`) and gated ViewSwitcher rendering; updated related tests to explicitly enable it where needed.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Updates `showViewSwitcher` JSDoc to indicate default hidden behavior. |
| packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx | Makes ViewSwitcher display opt-in via `schema.showViewSwitcher === true`. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Adds `showViewSwitcher` prop (default `false`) and conditionally renders ViewSwitcher. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx | Updates persistence-related test to enable ViewSwitcher explicitly. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewPersistence.test.tsx | Updates persistence tests to enable ViewSwitcher explicitly. |
</details>

`schema.showViewSwitcher` is now opt-in (`=== true`), but the plugin-view component registry still advertises `showViewSwitcher: true` in its `defaultProps` (see `packages/plugin-view/src/index.tsx`). That makes the effective default inconsistent with this change and with the updated schema JSDoc (@default false). Update the registry defaults (and any designer-generated defaults) to `false` so runtime behavior and generated schemas match.

This JSDoc ties the schema type to a specific UI implementation ("ViewDesigner") and overstates the behavior (the flag only controls whether the runtime shows switching UI; it doesn’t inherently "fix" the view type). Please reword to be implementation-agnostic, e.g. describe that the runtime view switcher controls are hidden by default and switching can only happen via configuration.

With `showViewSwitcher` defaulting to `false`, the ViewSwitcher UI is now omitted by default, but the test suite doesn’t assert this new default behavior. Add a test that renders `ListView` without `showViewSwitcher` and verifies that view-switcher buttons (e.g. aria-label "Grid"/"Kanban") are not present, so the new default is protected against regressions.
